mentl/ce5aa9d:
A lambda born inside a generic body inherits the parent's quantified vars,
so it twins under the same instantiation. Zero body rewriting: a worthy
demand contributes every record nested in its body (collect_fn_emit_records
over the parent, each mangled with the parent's enc), and the closure-mint
arm redirects the record's offset-0 table index through the bracket's
active enc — spec_closure_name, the LGlobal redirect's closure-mint face,
gated on the registry. Captures, self-binding, and local naming keep the
original name: the record local is the closure value, so self-recursive
nested closures work unchanged; only the index points at the twin body.
The bracket state widens from spec_wty to (spec_wty, spec_enc) via
spec_ctx_set/spec_ctx_clear/spec_enc_active on the one LookupTy handler,
and the handler-arm and continuation record mints take the same redirect.

Landing it surfaced a width-consistency break with reach beyond twins: a
param used only inside a nested lambda had no param-decl width source —
find_local_handle_expr stopped at the closure boundary, so emit_params
floored the declaration while the capture-store emitted the live handle's
width ((param $k i32) declared, $k.f64 read; undefined-local at assembly).
Captures and evs are parent-frame expressions — the walk now reads them,
bodies stay scoped out (the LFnRef arm was already the precedent). At the
floor both readers agree at the word, so word programs are byte-identical.

two-top/ceba63f:
The portfolio download refused to install on every phone that had a
phone.sh build: CI signed with its own cached keystore (cert 877ca748)
while the sideloads carry the dev box's debug key (cert 9e803341), and
Android reports a cross-key update as a bare App not installed. The
APK_KEYSTORE secret path is now wired: when the repo owner sets that
secret to their keystore (base64), CI signs with it and releases
install straight over sideloads; the cached/generated keystore remains
the fallback. apksigner now runs on every build and prints the signing
cert, because the alignment check read the ELF while nothing read the
signature — that blind spot is how a wrong-key build shipped silently.
SIDELOAD gains the troubleshooting row.

perennials/cefbe62:
Permapeople's CDN answers 403 for about one in seventeen of the 800px
originals while the 300px thumb beside it serves fine. sourceFor
returned photo ?? thumb, which only ever guarded against photo being
NULL and never against it being unfetchable, so the resizer threw, the
route returned 502, and the app drew its no-photo glyph. Measured over
240 plants that carry a photo: 5.8% broken, about 276 across the
catalogue, and they are the ones she plants -- Red mulberry, black
currant, hardy kiwi, highbush blueberry, shagbark hickory, columbine.

sourcesFor returns both URLs, best first, and render tries each until
one answers: a source that will not fetch, or will not decode, is a
source we do not have. Only when all of them fail does it throw, and
then the 502 is telling the truth. Falling back costs resolution and
never honesty, since withoutEnlargement already refuses to invent
pixels: a 300px thumb asked for 800 hands back 300 real ones.

Checked against Hyssop, whose 800px origin is one of the 403s: the old
path throws, the new one serves 64px and 192px from the thumb and
returns 300 real pixels for an 800 request.
